about_the_game: This is a first-person fast-paced action game with simple gameplay and an extremely satisfying feel. You play as a cybernetically enhanced warrior who accidentally inherits a memory disk from your former commander. Following the instructions of the people you encounter, you need to fight your way through hordes of enemies—all while fragmented memories gradually resurface. In the game, you can choose to equip different types of armor, weapons, cybernetic characters, and outfits. You will dash forward at high speed, slashing wildly at every enemy that stands in your path. The game adopts a fresh, bold cartoon art style, where character and scene designs blend Chinese-style armor, cold weapons, and sci-fi elements. Here, you can freely combine different weapons, characters, and armor to boost your combat power, allowing you to tackle various levels effectively. You can also choose outfits that match your personal taste to customize your appearance. During levels, you control the protagonist to move forward at high speed while adjusting directions left and right. Use attacks, combo moves, and skills to quickly take down enemies and carve a path through the chaos. Additionally, you will face a variety of fast-moving cavalry, elite warriors, and powerful bosses. Between levels, you can experience the game’s innovative storyline and unique worldbuilding. The game features incredibly simple controls that are easy to pick up, relying solely on basic keyboard inputs: the A and D keys control left and right movement, the W key triggers a forward slide, and the J key executes attacks.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of bloody violence. There is profanity in the characters' dialogue.
